title: Finishing Strong in Faith
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner challenges you to lay down the weights that are holding you back and run with freedom and strength in the name of Jesus. As you listen, you'll discover the dangers of distraction and how to prioritize your relationship with God above the demands of technology and the world. Join Pastor Chris as he guides you on a journey of faith, hope, and spiritual renewal, and learn how to finish strong in your walk with God.
